cities.name: Copenhagen
interests: Historic Streets & Old Town 🎭 — Cobblestone lanes, colorful façades and royal squares.
Harbors & Waterfront Walks 🌊 — Nyhavn, canals and lakes with big-sky reflections.
Museums & Culture 🎨 — Art galleries, design museums and classic Scandinavian culture.
Parks & Nature 🌿 — Green city parks, castle gardens and peaceful walking paths.
Local Food Exploration 😋 — Cinnamon rolls, smørrebrød, cozy cafés and modern Nordic bites.
cities.local_food_tip: Try fresh-baked Danish pastries, veggie smørrebrød on rye bread, warm soups, roasted root vegetables and Nordic grain bowls — light, cozy and full of Scandinavian flavor.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌊 Nyhavn Harbor: Colorful houses, boats and a fresh canal breeze. → 🏛️ Amalienborg Palace (Exterior): Royal square and guard ceremony area. → ⛪ View Frederik’s Church (Marble Church) from the outside. → ☕ Nordic bakery stop for cinnamon rolls and filter coffee. Afternoon: 🛍️ Walk along Strøget: pedestrian shopping street with cafés and street musicians. → 🌿 Relax in The King’s Garden near Rosenborg Castle. → 🎨 Exterior stop by SMK – National Gallery of Denmark. → 🍽️ Lunch: veggie smørrebrød, soups or Nordic salads. Sunset: 🌅 Walk around The Lakes — calm reflections, cyclists and locals jogging. Night: 🌃 Evening stroll near Tivoli Gardens (Exterior): lights, gardens and classic Copenhagen hygge.

ideas: 🌸 Blossoms in The King’s Garden.
🚶 Nyhavn walks in mild weather before peak crowds.
☕ Outdoor café terraces reopening across the city.
🚲 First bike rides of the season along canals and lakes.
🌊 Harbor walks around Nyhavn and Ofelia Plads.
🍓 Street food, cold drinks and harbor swimming zones.
🌇 Long Scandinavian sunsets over canals.
🌿 Picnics in Fælledparken.
🍁 Fall colors in parks and castle gardens.
🥧 Cinnamon rolls and hot drinks in cozy bakeries.
🎨 Museum visits at Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek.
🚶 Windy but atmospheric harbor walks.
🎄 Christmas markets at Tivoli Gardens.
🍫 Hot chocolate in candle-lit cafés.
✨ City light installations reflected in canals and lakes.
🏛️ Short museum visits paired with bakery stops.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚇 Metro runs 24/7 and connects the airport, city center and major districts quickly.
🚌 Buses complement metro routes and reach residential neighborhoods and outer areas.
🚲 Copenhagen is one of the world’s most bike-friendly cities with dedicated lanes everywhere — renting a bike is highly recommended.
🚆 S-trains connect the city center with suburbs and nearby towns for easy day trips.
📱 Use 'DOT Tickets' or Rejseplanen for tickets, routes and real-time journey planning.

cities.name: Aalborg
interests: Harbor Walks & Fjord Views 🌊 — Calm waterfront promenades and wide Limfjord horizons.
Art & Museums 🎨 — Modern architecture, street art and creative cultural hubs.
Urban Culture & Old Town 🎭 — Compact historic center, cafés and relaxed Danish vibes.
cities.local_food_tip: Look for Nordic-style salads, veggie sandwiches, soups, roasted vegetables and pastries — fresh, clean flavors perfect for a breezy harbor city.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌊 Walk along the Aalborg Waterfront: calm Limfjord paths with modern architecture. → 🏛️ Exterior visit to the Utzon Center, a cultural landmark designed by Jørn Utzon. → ☕ Coffee break at a riverside café with fjord views. Afternoon: 🎨 Explore Aalborg Street Art zones with large murals across the city. → 🏘️ Walk through Old Town streets: colorful houses, boutiques and small galleries. → 🍽️ Lunch: veggie sandwiches, Nordic bowls and warm soups. → 🌿 Relax on benches or small parks along the waterfront. Sunset: 🌅 Golden-hour views over the Limfjord from the harbor promenade. Night: 🌃 Calm evening walk with waterfront lights, dessert cafés and a relaxed atmosphere.

ideas: 🌼 Fresh flowers and greenery along Limfjord paths.
🚶 Mild old-town strolls and harbor walks.
☕ Outdoor café terraces reopening in the center.
📸 Soft spring light on murals and waterfront buildings.
🌊 Evening waterfront walks with cool fjord breezes.
🍦 Ice cream kiosks and pop-up food stands.
🌇 Long daylight hours perfect for slow exploration.
🎶 Open-air concerts and events near the harbor.
🍁 Warm tones in parks and along tree-lined streets.
🥧 Cozy cafés for pastries and hot drinks.
🎨 Museum and gallery visits on cooler days.
🌫️ Atmospheric foggy mornings by the fjord.
🎄 Soft festive lights in the city center.
🍫 Hot drinks near the waterfront cafés.
✨ Short evening walks with illuminated streets.
🏛️ Cultural stops followed by long café breaks.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Aalborg has a simple and reliable bus network connecting the city center, harbor and university areas.
🚲 Short distances and bike-friendly streets make cycling one of the easiest ways to get around.
🚆 Trains connect Aalborg with Aarhus, Copenhagen and towns across northern Jutland.
🚕 Taxis are readily available near the train station, waterfront and main squares.
📱 Use Rejseplanen for routes, connections and real-time travel planning.

cities.name: Aarhus

interests.name: Art & Museums 🎨
interests.description: Home to ARoS and other galleries, Aarhus offers contemporary art, immersive installations and a strong creative scene.

interests.name: Modern Architecture 🏛️
interests.description: Innovative Nordic design, new harbor districts and striking waterfront architecture.

interests.name: Parks & Nature 🌿
interests.description: Botanical gardens, forests and green escapes woven naturally into the city fabric.

interests.name: Local Food Exploration 😋
interests.description: Nordic bowls, bakeries, street food halls and cozy cafés focused on seasonal ingredients.

cities.local_food_tip: Look for veggie bowls, warm soups, fresh sourdough bread, salads and roasted root vegetables — classic Nordic comfort food with a modern, seasonal twist.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🎨 Visit or admire the exterior of ARoS Aarhus Art Museum, including the iconic rainbow panorama rooftop. → 🌿 Walk through the Aarhus Botanical Garden with hillside paths and greenhouses. → ☕ Scandinavian bakery stop for cinnamon buns and filter coffee. Afternoon: 🏘️ Explore the Latin Quarter: colorful streets, boutiques and relaxed cafés. → 🎨 Discover street art and creative corners near the city center. → 🍽️ Lunch at Aarhus Street Food with Nordic veggie bowls and international options. → 🌊 Walk along the harbor promenade for open sea views. Sunset: 🌅 Head to Aarhus Ø for modern waterfront viewpoints and golden reflections. Night: 🌃 Cozy evening walk through the Latin Quarter with dessert cafés, soft lights and calm city vibes.

ideas: 🌸 Botanical Garden blooms and fresh greenery.
🚶 Mild Latin Quarter strolls under soft sunshine.
☕ Outdoor café terraces with blankets and warm drinks.
🌿 Early leaves appearing in parks and along streams.
🌊 Cooling breezes along the harbor and Aarhus Ø.
🍦 Ice cream and cold drinks by the waterfront.
🌇 Long Nordic sunsets from ARoS rooftop and the harbor.
🏖️ Easy trips to nearby beaches like Den Permanente.
🍁 Forest walks in Marselisborg Forests.
🥧 Cozy bakeries with pastries and hot coffee.
🎨 Museum afternoons at ARoS and Moesgaard.
🌬️ Atmospheric windy walks along the coast.
🎄 Christmas lights in the Latin Quarter and city center.
🍫 Hot cocoa in candle-lit cafés.
🏛️ Short museum visits as warm indoor escapes.
✨ Evening harbor reflections under winter lights.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Aarhus has a reliable bus network connecting the city center with residential districts and main attractions.
🚉 The light rail (Letbanen) connects Aarhus with suburbs, beaches and nearby towns.
🚲 Excellent cycling infrastructure makes biking one of the easiest ways to get around the city.
🚶 Central areas like the Latin Quarter, harbor promenade and shopping streets are very walkable.

cities.name: Esbjerg
interests: Beaches & Sea Views 🌊 — Wide sandy coastlines and open horizons.
Coastal Nature 🌿 — Dunes, windswept paths and sea air.
Modern Landmarks 🏛️ — Striking seaside sculptures and architecture.
cities.local_food_tip: Choose veggie pasta, Nordic bread, salads, soups and warm roasted vegetables — simple, fresh and perfect after a breezy coastal day.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌊 Start with an Esbjerg Beach walk: dunes, sea breeze and long views. → 🏛️ Visit the iconic Man Meets the Sea sculptures (Exterior): huge white statues facing the water. → ☕ Coastal café stop with a view. Afternoon: 🌿 Stroll along the Esbjerg Harbor promenade. → 🏘️ Explore the small-town center streets. → 🍽️ Lunch with veggie sandwiches, soups and Nordic plates. → 🎨 Drop by local art corners or exterior of museums in the city center. Sunset: 🌅 Return to the beach area or sculpture viewpoint for golden hour over the sea. Night: 🌃 Quiet seaside lights, clear air and maybe a gelato or dessert on the way back.

☕ Terrace cafés with blankets and sea views.
📸 Clear spring skies over the sculptures.

🍉 Fresh fruit plates and snacks from local cafés.
🌇 Sunset by the 'Man Meets the Sea' sculptures.
🌊 Windy yet refreshing seaside bike rides.
🍁 Warm coastal tones in grasses and dunes.
🥧 Pastries and warm drinks in center cafés.
🎨 Art museum or cultural stops on stormy days.
🚶 Moody walks along the harbor in cooler winds.

cities.name: Odense
interests: Old Town Streets 🎭 — Cobbled lanes and storybook houses.
Museums & Culture 🎨 — Andersen-themed spots and art districts.
Parks & Nature 🌿 — Rivers, parks and green city pockets.
cities.local_food_tip: Try Nordic soups, salads, veggie plates, rye bread and pastries — warm, comforting and perfect for a fairytale-like city.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏘️ Explore the Hans Christian Andersen Quarter: fairytale-style old streets and colorful houses. → 🌿 Walk through Munke Mose Park along the river. → ☕ Cozy Danish café for coffee and pastries. Afternoon: 🎨 Head to the Brandts art area surroundings (Exterior): creative quarter and cultural spaces. → 🏰 Stroll around Odense Castle Gardens (Exterior). → 🍽️ Lunch with Nordic veggie dishes, soups and rye bread. → 🚶 Gentle riverwalk viewpoints in and near the park. Sunset: 🌅 Riverside golden colors near Munke Mose and central bridges. Night: 🌃 Old-town dessert shops, soft lights and quiet, storybook streets.

cities.name: Roskilde
interests: Historic Landmarks 🏛️ — Cathedral towers and royal tombs (from outside/inside if you wish).
Viking Culture 🎭 — Ships, history and fjord stories.
Seaside & Lake Views 🌊 — Roskilde Fjord and soft waterfront landscapes.
cities.local_food_tip: Look for veggie stews, Nordic bread, salads, soups and pastries — simple and traditional, ideal for a historic harbor town.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ View Roskilde Cathedral (Exterior, or interior if visiting): UNESCO-listed site with tall towers. → 🌊 Walk down toward Roskilde Fjord for peaceful water views. → ☕ Lakeside or fjordside café break. Afternoon: 🛶 See the exterior and harbor area around the Viking Ship Museum. → 🏘️ Wander through Old Town streets with small shops and historic houses. → 🍽️ Lunch with warm veggie stews, salads and Nordic bread. → 🌿 Short climbs to nearby hilltop viewpoints above the fjord. Sunset: 🌅 Fjord golden hour with boats, calm water and pastel skies. Night: 🌃 Lakeside or old-town evening walk with dessert or a warm drink.

🚶‍♂️ Lake and fjord walks in mild weather.
